This event is generated when a successful command sent to the TPM resets the TPM lockout logic.  With this event, all prior standard user TPM authorization failures are ignored; allowing standard users to use the TPM normally again immediately.

event(fields): Event_21(UnicodeString UserSID, UnicodeString ProcessPath)
evtlog_message: A standard user issued Trusted Platform Module (TPM) command returned an authorization failure. This event is generated when a command sent to the TPM by a standard user returns a response indicating an authorization failure.  If too many authorization failures occur, standard users may be temporarily prevented from sending TPM commands requiring authorization.  This helps prevent the TPM from entering a hardware lockout because of too many authorization failures. \r\nUser Security ID:%1. \r\nProcess Path %2.

event(fields): Event_23(UnicodeString UserSID)

This helps prevent the TPM from entering a hardware lockout because of too many authorization failures. \r\nUser Security ID:%1.
